contact.page.title: Contact
contact.page.intro: If you have a question about your account, a contribution, a payment or how PotSecret works, you can contact us easily. We do our best to reply in a clear, human and reassuring way.
contact.page.supportUserDescription: Need help accessing your account, finding a money pool or understanding how PotSecret works? We’re here to guide you simply.
contact.page.paymentIssueDescription: If something blocked your contribution, if a confirmation is taking too long, or if you have a Stripe-related question, we can help you check what happened.
contact.page.generalQuestionDescription: For any other request, feedback or question about the service, feel free to write to us and we’ll reply with care.
contact.page.supportEmailIntro: You can also write to us directly at:
contact.page.formDescription: You can also prepare your message here. The form is ready to be connected to server-side processing.
contact.form.name: Name
contact.form.messagePlaceholder: Describe your question or the issue you ran into.
contact.form.success: Message sent. Thank you, we’ll get back to you shortly.
contact.form.error: We couldn’t send your message right now. Please check the fields or contact us by email.

public.payment.subtitle: You’re taking part in a surprise money pool. Thank you for your discretion.
public.payment.trust3: Individual amounts stay hidden from other participants
public.payment.faq1.question: Do I need an account to pay?
public.payment.faq1.answer: No, you can contribute without creating an account.
public.payment.faq2.question: Is the payment secure?
public.payment.faq2.answer: Yes, payments are secured through Stripe.
public.payment.faq3.question: Is my amount visible to others?

public.payment.form.subtitle: Just a few details are enough to confirm your contribution.

public.payment.form.stripePlaceholderBod: Connect CardElement or Payment Element here during the final Stripe integration.
public.payment.form.summaryFeeNote: A 4% platform fee is only deducted when the beneficiary payout is made.
public.payment.form.fastSafe: Your contribution is quick, secure and discreet.
public.success.statusConfirmed: Your contribution is confirmed and has been counted in the money pool.
public.success.statusPaidPending: Your payment has been received. Final confirmation is still syncing.
public.success.statusUnpaid: The payment has not yet been confirmed by Stripe.
public.cancel.body: Your payment was not completed. You can resume your contribution whenever you like.
public.cancel.info: No amount is confirmed until the payment is fully completed in Stripe.
